snippet.title: QUTAS67 | Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067 - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094790/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=yt_trailer
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020649
Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/qutas67-qubic-ultimate-tap-adventure-simulator-2067/9NT5Z9B7TQG9

Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067 invites players to build a criminal empire in a neon-soaked future where technology has advanced and common sense has not.

Start with a dumpster and work your way up to increasingly valuable targets across 20 locations. Collect more than 90 absurd artifacts, make questionable deals at your pawn shop, and recruit eccentric Managers to help expand your operation.

Beyond the business, discover a world packed with pop-culture references, satirical broadcasts on 67 FM, and absurd posts on the fictional social network Fake Socials. Play more than 10 minigames to earn rewards that support your empire’s growth.

There is more to this adventure than meets the eye. Further reveals and plenty of surprises await, with the biggest discoveries left for players to make themselves.
